verdict.rationale: Luma's Modify Video V2 is documented as reshaping existing footage by swapping specific elements ('the wall, the world, the wardrobe') while 'the lighting holds'. Video-to-video and product adaptation without reshoots back up targeted edits to existing clips. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how an element is selected or masked, explicit evidence that untouched regions stay pixel-intact, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Modify Video results.
